SourceProxy._comment: Generic allowlisted CORS+range caching proxy: GET /src?url=<https url>. EMPTY means the proxy refuses everything - an open proxy would let anyone launder requests through this host and spend its bandwidth. Large downloads REDIRECT, so a source usually needs more than one host listed (GitHub releases land on objects.githubusercontent.com). Subdomains of a listed host are allowed.
SourceProxy._evictionComment: The cache is bounded so a full drive cannot take the tracker and web seed down with it. MaxCacheSizeBytes 100 GB, MinFreeDiskSpaceBytes 20 GB - the floor has to exceed the largest single thing that can arrive (the fp32 ZipVoice archive alone is 634 MB), because the check runs BEFORE a fetch and a floor smaller than one download would trip only after the damage.
